text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Signed-control effects across the complete SNR grid
Thin: paired patient 95% CI, conditional on fixed checkpoints/noises/modes. Thick: +/-1 training-seed SD (3 seeds); these are separate, not combined.
Positive AUROC/F1: first condition better; positive ECE: first condition worse. All values in percentage points.
Horizontal offsets are visual only: ResNet -0.13, TCN +0.13 tick units; CI -0.065 and SD +0.065 around each model.
S = mean across all five frozen signed modes. Grey band marks 0 dB, not an uncertainty region.
